title: OpenPLC CANopen master configuration, schema_version 1
description: The CANopen plugin's JSON config (conf/canopen.json, canopen_config.json). Unknown fields are allowed: the plugin and the deploy tool ignore them with a warning. Checks this schema cannot express are listed in docs/config.md.

nodes.description: The slave nodes. May be empty only when master.diagnostics is given (a scan-only configuration).

bitrate.description: A CiA 301 bit rate in bit/s.

device.description: slcan: absolute path of the serial device; /dev/serial/by-id/... keeps working when the device number changes.

serial_baudrate.description: slcan: UART speed for adapters behind a real serial port (FTDI-based CANUSB). USB CDC adapters such as the CANable ignore it.

simulate.description: true: the network is simulated (docs/simulator.md). No CAN interface or serial device is used; the other adapter fields are kept and checked. A master network and a slave network with the same interface name share one simulated bus (docs/slave.md, Simulated bus).

adapter.description: The CAN adapter. 'socketcan': an existing SocketCAN interface (CAN HAT, candleLight/gs_usb, PEAK, vcan). 'slcan': a serial-line adapter (CANable with slcan firmware, Lawicel CANUSB); the plugin creates the interface from the serial device.

sync_period_us.description: SYNC period of the master's timer. Omitted or 0: no SYNC timer; without "sync_source": "plc_cycle" the master then produces no SYNC, and every configured PDO must be event-driven. Not allowed with "sync_source": "plc_cycle".

sync_source.description: Where SYNC comes from: "timer" (default, every sync_period_us) or "plc_cycle" (one SYNC every sync_cycles PLC cycles, sent at the start of the cycle).

sync_cycles.description: With "sync_source": "plc_cycle": PLC cycles per SYNC, 1-1000. Default 1.

eds_lint.description: Which dcfgen EDS lint findings stop the load: communication (default) only findings in 0x1000-0x1FFF that are not only about limits, all every finding, off none. Accepted findings are logged as one warning per EDS.

strict_eds.description: Deprecated; true is eds_lint "all", false is eds_lint "off". Not together with eds_lint.

bus_state_location.description: An input byte (%IB...) the plugin keeps at the CAN bus state: 0 no bus, 1 error-active, 2 error-warning, 3 error-passive, 4 bus-off.

tx_error_count_location.description: An input byte (%IB...) with the CAN controller's transmit error counter, clamped to 255.

rx_error_count_location.description: An input byte (%IB...) with the CAN controller's receive error counter, clamped to 255.

bus_off_count_location.description: An input word (%IW...) counting bus-off events since the PLC started; wraps at 65535.

state_location.description: An input byte (%IB...) the plugin keeps at the master's own NMT state: 5 OPERATIONAL, 127 PRE-OPERATIONAL, 4 STOPPED, 0 resetting or not started.

vendor_id.description: The master's own identity object 0x1018 sub-index 1.

sync_window_us.description: Synchronous window length (0x1007) in microseconds; 0 = none.

sync_counter_overflow.description: SYNC counter overflow value (0x1019): 0 sends SYNC without a counter, 2-240 adds a counter that runs 1..value.

time_cob_id.description: COB-ID of the master's TIME message (0x1012), default 0x100. With time_period_ms the master sets the producer bit (bit 30) itself.

emcy_inhibit_time_us.description: Inhibit time of the master's own EMCY (0x1015), in microseconds.

heartbeat_consumer.description: The master watches the nodes' heartbeats (0x1016). Default true.

heartbeat_multiplier.description: A node with heartbeat_consumer watches the master's heartbeat with heartbeat_ms x this as its timeout. Default 3.

start.description: The master goes OPERATIONAL by itself after boot-up (0x1F80 bit 2). Default true; false leaves the network PRE-OPERATIONAL.

start_nodes.description: The master starts the nodes (0x1F80 bit 3). Default true; false leaves them PRE-OPERATIONAL after configuration.

start_all_nodes.description: Start all nodes with one NMT command once the master is OPERATIONAL (0x1F80 bit 1). Default false.

reset_all_nodes.description: Reset all nodes when a mandatory node fails (0x1F80 bit 4). Default false.

stop_all_nodes.description: Stop all nodes, and the master, when a mandatory node fails (0x1F80 bit 6). Default false.

boot_time_ms.description: Time allowed for all mandatory nodes to boot (0x1F89); 0 = no limit.

time_period_ms.description: Produce TIME (CiA 301 TIME_OF_DAY from the host clock) at once when the bus comes up and then every time_period_ms, 100-3600000 ms, on time_cob_id or 0x100. Left out, the master sends no TIME.

sdo_timeout_ms.description: Timeout of every SDO the master sends to boot and configure a node (identity reads, PDO and startup SDO downloads, restore, firmware download), 10-60000 ms. Default 1000. SDO variables and diagnostics requests keep their own timeouts.

diagnostics.description: The diagnostics channel: the plugin listens on TCP for the configurator's online view, manual SDO/NMT and network scan (docs/diagnostics.md). Absent = no network listener.

token_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the access token, as 64 hexadecimal characters (openplc-canopen-diag hash-token prints it). The token itself is never stored in the config.

bind.description: IPv4 address to listen on (default 0.0.0.0, all interfaces).

allow_changes.description: Allow SDO writes and NMT commands from clients (default false: read-only).

state_location.description: An input byte (%IB...) the plugin keeps at the node's NMT state: 4 STOPPED, 5 OPERATIONAL, 127 PRE-OPERATIONAL, 0 no contact.

boot_error_location.description: An input byte (%IB...) with the ASCII code of the CiA 302 error status of the node's last failed boot (66 B no response, 68 D vendor, 74 J configuration refused, 77 M product code, 78 N revision, 79 O serial number); 0 while it is operational.

emcy_code_location.description: An input word (%IW...) holding the error code of the node's latest emergency (EMCY) message; 0 when no error is active (after an error reset or a boot-up message).

error_register_location.description: An input byte (%IB...) holding the error register (object 0x1001) from the node's latest emergency (EMCY) message; 0 after a boot-up message.

nmt_command_location.description: An output byte (%QB...) through which the program commands the node with CiA 301 NMT codes: 0 or 1 run normally, 2 keep STOPPED, 128 keep PRE-OPERATIONAL; a change to 129 sends RESET NODE once, to 130 RESET COMMUNICATION once.

mandatory.description: The master does not go OPERATIONAL until this node has booted (0x1F81 bit 3). Default false.

boot.description: The master boots and configures the node (0x1F81 bit 2). Default true; false leaves the node to itself.

reset_communication.description: The master may reset the node's communication at start (0x1F81 bit 4 inverted). Default true.

revision_number.description: Expected 0x1018 sub-index 3. Left out, the EDS value; 0 turns the revision check off.

serial_number.description: Expected 0x1018 sub-index 4. Left out, not checked.

heartbeat_consumer.description: The node watches the master's heartbeat (its 0x1016). Needs master heartbeat_ms. Left out, the node's EDS entries stay.

time_cob_id.description: The node's TIME COB-ID (0x1012). Left out, the EDS value stays.

restore_configuration.description: Sub-index of 0x1011 the master restores before configuring the node. Left out, none.

config_check.description: Skip the configuration download when the node's 0x1020 (configuration date and time) holds this configuration's stamp; after a download the master writes the stamp. Needs a writable 0x1020 sub 1 and 2 in the EDS. Default false.

store_configuration.description: Sub-index of 0x1010 (1-127) the master writes "save" to after a download, so the node keeps its configuration in non-volatile memory. Needs config_check, so the node saves only when its configuration changed. Left out, the node is never told to save.

lss.description: LSS (CiA 305): give the device this node's ID by its identity (EDS vendor ID and product code, serial_number, revision_number when set and not 0) at every master start, before any node boots. Absent = no LSS for this node.

assign.description: Find the device by its LSS address and set its node ID to node_id when it differs. Needs serial_number and reset_communication true. Default false.

store.description: After setting a new node ID, store it in the device's non-volatile memory (LSS store configuration). Never when the ID was already right. Needs assign. Default false.

axis.description: The node is a CiA 402 drive used by the PLC program as one PLCopen axis (AXIS_REF_SM3 of the editor's built-in PLCopen SoftMotion library), named after the node. Its standard objects (0x6040, 0x6041, ...) are found in the node's PDO mapping; needs status_location. The plugin does nothing different on the bus. See docs/cia402.md.

scale_numerator.description: Axis iRatioTechUnitsNum (DINT): increments per technical unit together with scale_denominator and scale_factor. Default 1.

software_file.description: Program file the master downloads to the node (0x1F50) when its software version (0x1F56) differs from software_version. Relative to the config folder.

software_version.description: Expected program software version (0x1F56 sub-index 1). Needs software_file.

sdo.description: Startup SDOs, written in list order after the PDO parameters and before NMT start.

sdo_variables.description: Objects moved over SDO between the node and IEC locations while the network runs: read entries land in an input location, write entries come from an output location.

simulate.description: true: this node is a simulated device run by the plugin (docs/simulator.md). Default: true on a simulated network (adapter.simulate), false on a real one.

cob_id.description: 11-bit COB-ID, or "auto": the CiA 301 default for PDOs 1-4, a free COB-ID for higher PDOs.

event_timer_ms.description: Sub-index 5: on a TPDO the event timer, on an RPDO the node's deadline. Left out, the EDS value stays.

inhibit_time_us.description: TPDO only. Sub-index 3, in microseconds (a multiple of 100). Left out, the EDS value stays.

mapping.description: Who sets the PDO's mapping: "config" (the master writes it from entries) or "device" (the node keeps its EDS default mapping; entries name the mapped objects the PLC uses). Left out: "device" when the EDS makes the mapping read-only, else "config".

timeout_ms.description: TPDO only (tx_pdos). Receive timeout: the deadline of the master's own RPDO for this PDO, in milliseconds (1-65535), or "auto" for two times the PDO's event timer (event_timer_ms, else the EDS value; refused when that is 0). Left out, the PDO is not monitored.

on_timeout.description: TPDO only, with timeout_ms. What the PDO's inputs show while it is timed out: "hold" (default, the last values) or "zero".

timeout_location.description: TPDO only, with timeout_ms. An input bit (%IX...) that is TRUE while the PDO is timed out and its node is up.

sync_start.description: TPDO only, with a synchronous transmission type (1-240). Sub-index 6. Left out, the EDS value stays.

value.description: A JSON number (true/false for BOOLEAN), or an integer as a decimal or 0x hex string. Must fit the type.

uint_string.description: An unsigned integer written as a string, decimal or 0x hex ("0x2001", "8193"). Its range is checked by the plugin, not by this schema.

us100.description: Microseconds for a CiA object counted in 100 us: a multiple of 100, at most 6553500.

error_behavior.description: Object 0x1029 (error behavior): sub-index (1-254, as a string key) to value (0 = pre-operational, 1 = no change, 2 = stopped, others manufacturer-specific).

direction.description: read: device to an input location (after each boot, every period_ms, on each trigger edge). write: an output location to the device (without a trigger: after each boot and on change; with a trigger: on its rising edge).

period_ms.description: Read entries only: read again every period (10 ms or more) while the node is available.

trigger_location.description: An output bit (%QX...): each rising edge reads or writes the entry once.

status_location.description: An input byte (%IB...): 0 nothing yet, 1 busy, 2 done, 3 aborted, 4 node not available.

abort_code_location.description: An input double word (%ID...): CiA 301 abort code of the latest aborted transfer, 0 after a successful one.
